Name: [CP] ChefRudes More Interesting Menagerie
Author: ChefRude
TagLine: A content patcher mod that allows you to replace the vanilla animals and livestock with those from the "Wandering Ones" mega-mod.
Description:
Make your Farm Animal Menagerie More Interesting!

﻿This Content Patcher mod allows you to replace the vanilla animals and livestock with those from the "Wandering Ones" mega-mod.These include:
Hereford & Jersey Cows
Suffolk Sheep
Varius Gallus & Desi Murga Chickens (Purple Void chickens and new Blue Chickens too!)
Goats with Bandannas
Pink "Traveling woman" pigs
Harlequin Rabbits

:computer: To Install :computer:

Make sure you have SMAPI﻿ and Content Patcher﻿ installed
Download the CP ChefRudes More Interesting Managerie file, and unpack it
Drag it to your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
Enjoy!

:wrench: Configuration Options :wrench: 

This mod allows you to configure which animals you want to replace from the base game. After you load the game the first time, with the mod installed a config.json will be added to the mod folder.

Your options are configurable to true :white_check_mark: or false :x: and include:

ChangeChickens (changes all chickens: Void, White, Brown, and Blue)
ChangeDucks 
ChangeRabbits
ChangePigs
ChangeSheep
ChangeCows (Changes both cows)
ChangeGoats

:bangbang: Known Conflicts :bangbang:

Combining this mod with BFAV will replace Store Icons with vanilla animals. But you should still be able to use the animal replacements.
